title: FUMI Salty Raspberry Nicotine Pouches
description: FUMi Salty Raspberry Nicotine Pouches pair bright, fruity Raspberry with a subtle twist of Liquorice to create a flavour that’s both familiar and deliciously unexpected. Sweet and sharp with added spicy depth, this pouch offers a distinctive option within the range. Each slim, all-white pouch sits discreetly under the lip and releases nicotine and flavour gradually for up to 30 minutes. Free from tobacco, vapour and odour, they’re a convenient and clean alternative to more traditional formats. Choose between 4mg (Regular) or 8mg (Strong) depending on your preference. Each can contains 20 plant-based pouches made to high standards in Sweden by Helix AB. Nicotine Range: Regular - 4mg this is best for new users. Extra Strong - 11mg this is suited for more experienced users. How to Use Nicotine Pouches: Please Note: DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH
